All 76 failing versions (the 72 corpus failures, plus the 5 on line 1; v9.03 failed twice) now have a row in `tools\handoff\console\notes\corpus-triage.md`. Each row has a verdict, a one-line reason, the fix and status OPEN, grouped by cause. I re-ran each version alone, then read the check and the game code it tests. I changed nothing and shipped nothing.

- **REAL (1):** v27.38. A medal now puts two lines in the feed. The score change from $ to SP (lean2) broke three text matches in the feed code, around lines 19307, 19323 and 19324. A medal's point label, a kill popup and a pickup tag no longer match them. The fix is one small mk-cw script.
- **FLAKY (11):** v28.48, 28.16, 28.13, 28.12, 19.00, 18.25, 17.86, 17.75, 9.93 and 9.92 pass when run alone. v10.68 is the rarity-variant roll. Reopen v28.48 as REAL if it fails again alone, since it matters for 10/30.
- **The three suspects:**
  - **v28.48 (2P shield bubble):** FLAKY. The bubble flag is sent, kept, relayed and drawn correctly. The corpus failure was an arc count compared against an earlier count.
  - **v27.00 (needed-item glow):** STALE. The world glow was removed on purpose by lean6, his 10-15 order "get rid of the shining circle for items".
  - **v25.26 (Longshot length):** STALE. The game draws the Longshot longer, but the check's drawing canvas is too narrow after the bigger guns (guns2x) and clips it.
- **STALE (64):** the biggest group is the belt-to-wheel and fixed gun-key change (27 rows). Then come the feed and alert lane replacing the old message rows (11), and run card, stash, Keys list, map marker and kit redesigns (12). Score $ to SP covers 5 rows, the melee key move (F to Q to V) covers 4, and crawler damage, the rampage boss and the siren take 5 more.
- **Low confidence:** v23.41, v22.59, v24.19, v20.92 and v10.46 are marked "(low)". v23.41 (NEW HIGH SCORE never said) and v22.59 (BACKPACK FULL drawn twice) could still turn out to be real bugs, so check them first. For v23.41 the game code looks unchanged; the likely cause is that the check's rows don't fit the board's tonight window or mode tag, but I couldn't confirm it without a probe run. For v22.59 the pickup stack is no longer drawn, and the two text hits are probably the feed line's shadow pass.

The file ends with a suggested order: the v27.38 fix first, then one fixq pass each for score SP, feed, and melee, then retire the belt checks in bulk, then the UI redesign group and the mixed rows.

TASK DONE
